**Metric explanation:** "Revenue" here is total net sales reported under US GAAP concept `RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax` — the full-year total (products + services, North America, International, and AWS), a 365-day duration from 2023-01-01 to 2023-12-31, in USD.

**Result:** For fiscal year 2023 (ended 2023-12-31), Amazon.com Inc. (CIK 1018724) reported revenue of $574,785,000,000. This matches the frozen evidence entry and the tool lookup, both drawn from the FY2023 Form 10-K, accession **0001018724-24-000008**, filed 2024-02-02 (source: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1018724/000101872424000008/0001018724-24-000008-index.htm).

For context, the prior-year (FY2022) figure was $513,983,000,000 (accession 0001018724-23-000004), implying ~11.8% growth, though the requested target is the FY2023 level itself.

ANSWER: $574,785,000,000 (USD)
